variables.identity: Observed landmark silhouettes, architecture, materials and palette from actual game references
variables.individualComposition: Distinct scene, framing, weather and quiet crop area
variables.sourceClientVersion: Verified exact installed-client patch, for example 3.7.14.18

exports.background: Opaque watercolor and warm off-white paper
exports.framing: Landmark inside central 60% width and 70% height; lower-left remains quiet for profile avatar

continuityRules: Inspect real references from the current Unity game; do not substitute Retro maps or unrelated fantasy scenery.
Use the approved portrait for linework and watercolor only, never its character or composition.
Give every place its own framing, palette and atmosphere, retaining recognizable Dofus architecture.
No labels, logos, watermarks, interface, characters or fake handwritten notes.
Save the exact final prompt and source URLs, retain PNG masters locally, then export WebP and record dimensions and hashes.
Review full 3:1, narrow mobile and avatar-overlap crops before integration.

Register each new path in PROFILE_BANNERS with its label in all four locales. Add an admin-authored profile_banner_catalog SQL migration and mirror the inserts in schema.sql. Apply the migration before releasing the new picker choices and run the catalog parity and database checks.

For the 3.7 expansion, use installed-client map assets from the verified 3.7 branch as the environment references. Earlier screenshots and other game branches do not establish current identity. Existing Forge artwork may be used for technique only. Record the exact client patch on each new banner and every map reference.

referencePreparation.provenance: Record the installed client version, source map ids, map bundle hashes and reference PNG hashes. Static map planes omit runtime effects and are not exact game screenshots. Use them for identity only; compose original fan art.
